video:video.video:title: Okaeri — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for Okaeri — a cozy pet homecoming slide puzzle by PixelRyu. Slide rows and columns, rotate the outer ring, and bring every pet home.

video:video.video:title: Shizuku — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Shizuku — a cozy, deterministic physics puzzle by PixelRyu set in a quiet Japanese garden. You never touch the dewdrops; you arrange the board — bamboo flumes, stones and leaves — so that, when two drops fall, they roll, slide and meet to become one. Set the scene, release the drops, watch your plan play out. 12 languages. Out now on the App Store and Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play.

video:video.video:title: SENKO — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: SENKO by PixelRyu — cozy incense-smoke puzzle. Calm the dark smoke white and guide it into Japanese motifs over 120 quiet stages. On App Store and Roblox.

video:video.video:title: WAGASHI — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for WAGASHI — a cozy Japanese-sweets merge puzzle by PixelRyu. Drop a sweet into the vessel; two of the same merge into the next, climbing a 10-step chain from a tiny azuki bean to a grand kagami-mochi. Soft physics, two modes and two tools. Now on Roblox; Android testers welcome on Google Play; coming soon to the App Store.

video:video.video:title: CounterParts — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for CounterParts by PixelRyu — a cozy mirror-twin grid puzzle. One swipe moves two twins, Gold and Platinum, one cell each in opposite directions; line both up to rest in their matching-color holes inside a little brass tally counter.

video:video.video:title: TEMARI — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for TEMARI by PixelRyu — a first-person paddle breakout in a cozy Japanese night. Move your hagoita with a fingertip, keep the temari in an endless rally, and pop every paper balloon down the lantern-lit corridor.

video:video.video:title: TATAMI: Lay the Floor — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for TATAMI: Lay the Floor — a cozy tatami-laying block puzzle in a quiet Japanese room by PixelRyu. Complete a full row or column to finish the line; a samurai delivers the mats to the tatami magistrate for koban. 48 stages, free.

video:video.video:title: Bounce Cat — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Bounce Cat — a cozy maze-escape puzzle by PixelRyu. Fire a ball of yarn from outside the maze, ride the ricochet, and shift or shatter walls so the trapped cat finds its own way out. 200 mazes across 10 worlds.

video:video.video:title: HAYATE — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Official trailer for HAYATE — a 3D katana speed-racer by PixelRyu, and a sequel to ISSEN. Race the highway, space, the deep and the sky; dodge what flies at you, or throw your homing katana to slice it clean.

video:video.video:title: Sumlings — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Sumlings — a cozy number puzzle by PixelRyu. Place number eggs into a tiny terrarium, match each nest's total to its target, and hatch the cute Sumlings.

video:video.video:title: Parcel Pals — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: Parcel Pals — a cozy parcel-sorting puzzle by PixelRyu. Sort cute parcels into 3 lanes, match shapes to boxes, and ship before the table overflows.

video:video.video:title: ISSEN — Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: ISSEN — a sumi-e timing-action game of the iaido draw by PixelRyu.

video:video.video:title: HOTARU — The Lost House: Official Trailer
video:video.video:description: HOTARU — a quiet Japanese horror walking simulator by PixelRyu.

video:video.video:title: Liquid Glow — Official Trailer (New Version, iPhone & Roblox)
video:video.video:description: Liquid Glow by PixelRyu — a calm, luminous color-matching puzzle in deep space. Slide glowing light along the constellation so every ring matches its color.
